#!/bin/bash
# LEAD-6 review of W3R2 item 3 (maker TS): one slot-gate job (--n 2), run in the trial worktree /home/user/wt/w8tr-q/kettle
# (trial 6babf87, tests 59f5e49 = pe/w3r2-test-stability@21e5644), against the integration dev server :5560 (src unchanged).
#   A  under load (2 workers + 4 CPU burners, own PIDs, killed by PID; recipe of W3R1/review/FINAL/scripts/LR-stress.sh):
#      notice-strip 844x390 dark 200 % x10, then timer :156 + :189 x10 in project timer-app
#   C  injected races (no burners, 1 worker), the maker's scratch copies regenerated by its mkinject.py into .tmp/lead6/ts:
#      timer old/new (both tests, both projects, x1); notice old transient, new transient, new permanent
#   D  the whole notice-strip.spec.ts once (--workers=2, no burners)
#   E  only if A's notice run failed and time allows: the maker's diagnostic copy under the same load x10
K=/home/user/wt/w8tr-q/kettle
OUT=/home/user/Vibei/kettle/review/product-excellence/contracts/W3R2/review/LEAD6/TS
L=$K/.tmp/lead6
cd $K || exit 9
PIDS=""
burn_on() { for i in 1 2 3 4; do ( while :; do :; done ) & PIDS="$PIDS $!"; done; echo "burners:$PIDS started $(date -u +%T) load $(cut -d' ' -f1-3 /proc/loadavg)"; sleep 5; }
burn_off() { [ -n "$PIDS" ] && kill $PIDS 2>/dev/null; wait $PIDS 2>/dev/null; echo "burners stopped $(date -u +%T): $(for p in $PIDS; do kill -0 $p 2>/dev/null && echo "$p ALIVE" || echo "$p gone"; done | tr '\n' ' ')"; PIDS=""; }
trap burn_off EXIT
run() { # <name> <workers> <args...>
  local name=$1 w=$2; shift 2
  echo "######## $name: KETTLE_PORT=5560 npx playwright test $* --workers=$w"
  echo "### start $(date -u +%T) load $(cut -d' ' -f1-3 /proc/loadavg)"
  env KETTLE_PORT=5560 PLAYWRIGHT_JSON_OUTPUT_NAME=$L/out/$name.json npx playwright test "$@" --workers=$w --reporter=list,json --output=$L/out/$name
  local rc=$?
  echo "### end $(date -u +%T) exit=$rc load $(cut -d' ' -f1-3 /proc/loadavg)"
  echo
  return $rc
}
STAGE=${1:-all}
if [ "$STAGE" = all ] || [ "$STAGE" = A ]; then
  {
    burn_on
    run A-notice844-x10 2 tests/notice-strip.spec.ts --project=chromium --repeat-each=10 -g 'real input \(844×390 dark 200 %\)'
    echo $? > $L/out/A-notice.rc
    run A-timer156-189-x10 2 tests/timer.spec.ts --project=timer-app --repeat-each=10 -g 'background: the worker|hidden page: completion'
    burn_off
  } > $OUT/A-underload.log.txt 2>&1
fi
if [ "$STAGE" = all ] || [ "$STAGE" = C ]; then
  {
    for v in old new; do
      run C-timer-$v 1 -c .tmp/lead6/ts-pw.config.ts ts/$v/timer.spec.ts --project=timer-harness --project=timer-app -g 'background: the worker|hidden page: completion'
    done
    for vm in old:transient new:transient new:permanent; do
      v=${vm%%:*}; m=${vm##*:}
      export COVER=$m; run C-notice-$v-$m 1 -c .tmp/lead6/ts-pw.config.ts ts/$v/notice-strip.spec.ts --project=chromium -g 'real input \(844×390 dark 200 %\)'
    done
    unset COVER
  } > $OUT/C-inject.log.txt 2>&1
fi
if [ "$STAGE" = all ] || [ "$STAGE" = D ]; then
  run D-notice-whole 2 tests/notice-strip.spec.ts --project=chromium > $OUT/D-notice-whole.log.txt 2>&1
fi
if [ "$STAGE" = all ] || [ "$STAGE" = E ]; then
  if [ "$(cat $L/out/A-notice.rc 2>/dev/null)" != 0 ] && [ "$(date -u +%H%M)" -lt 1945 ]; then
    {
      burn_on
      run E-diag844-x10 2 -c .tmp/lead6/ts-pw.config.ts ts/diag/notice-strip.spec.ts --project=chromium --repeat-each=10 -g 'real input \(844×390 dark 200 %\)'
      burn_off
    } > $OUT/E-diag-underload.log.txt 2>&1
  else
    echo "E skipped $(date -u +%T): A-notice rc=$(cat $L/out/A-notice.rc 2>/dev/null)" > $OUT/E-diag-underload.log.txt
  fi
fi
